---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or new capability for NodeRadar Pro
title: '[FEAT] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**Problem Statement**
A clear description of what problem or missing visibility this feature addresses (e.g. "I cannot identify multicast DNS devices on VLAN 20...").

**Proposed Solution**
A clear description of the capability or protocol you want added.

**Technical Context & Alternatives**
Describe any protocols, APIs or existing tools you considered (e.g. Win32 APIs, UDP socket probes, LLMNR/WS-Discovery mechanics).

**Use Case**
Explain how this helps systems administrators, network engineers or homelab operators.
